leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open right now — the balance is comfortably positive and pending bids do not deduct until they land. If every live and recommended leg lands, the balance goes briefly negative before the unwind, but by materially less than the previous run projected thanks to the matchday prize, and the two funding sales more than clear it back to positive with days to spare. The lock is still most of a week away, so there is no timing pressure on the unwind itself. The rule that governs it is unchanged and absolute: a negative balance when the matchday starts scores zero for the entire matchday, so the sales must be completed before the lock regardless of how tempting it is to hold value.

binding_gap: The empty squad slot, and behind it the fact that no legal formation can currently be filled. This is not a value question or a points question — it is a penalty being paid every matchday it goes unfixed, and it outranks every upgrade on the board. It is fixed by buying any outfield body at all, and fixed best by buying the one outfield body who is also the strongest points upgrade available. The safety net stands: if the blind auctions are lost overnight and the squad is still short by midday tomorrow, take any cheap outfield player immediately rather than waiting for a good one, because there is still ample time before the lock but no more excuses for carrying the penalty. Never a second keeper.

verdict.headline: One thing needs doing and it has not been done.
verdict.headline_short: One thing needs doing and it has not been done.
verdict.detail: One thing needs doing and it has not been done. The squad is a player short, fills no legal formation, and is carrying a live points penalty into MD2 — and the single board entry that fixes it, Jano ter Horst of Paderborn, still shows zero offers against it, ours included. The call was made at the previous run and nothing has changed to weaken it: he is fit, he played the full match in Paderborn's back three at Mainz, he is absent from Ligainsider's injury and suspension table on a re-check this run, his market value is still rising, and Paderborn are at home to Freiburg. He is simultaneously the missing body and the best points-per-euro of any verified starter on the board. His listing expires overnight German time, so the practical window to act is tonight. Everything else this run is confirmation, not change.

sell.reason: No sale should happen yet, and that brake is the important part of this briefing. At the current squad size a sale deepens the hole rather than funding anything. The order is fixed: a buy has to land first. The moment any buy lands, Sylla goes back to Kickbase — his selection value is half dead, his market value is bleeding daily, and Schalke have him as their number one sale candidate with the German window shutting tomorrow evening and the Belgian window open several days beyond it. Bernardo follows as the second funding sale; he was hooked early on matchday 1 for his direct competitor, carries a knock flag on Kickbase, and his value is falling faster than anyone else's in the squad. Lokonga and Widmer remain designated sales behind those two — Lokonga on quality rather than availability, Widmer as the cheap twelfth body to keep if only one buy lands.

standing.name: Sylla
standing.why: Replaces SELL-syl (closed) - PROMOTED from "funding leg 1, only if a bid lands" to the FIRST sale to execute, with a hard deadline. NEW: fussballeuropa 31.08.2026 08:45Z - Club Brugge intends to bid before the deadline, Schalke has cut the ask to a EUR 4M minimum and is only deciding whether letting him go now makes sporting sense; CEO Tillmann: a sale "is currently included in our budget figures". Corroborated by schalketotal 24.08/26.08/27.08 (Schalke needs the transfer millions, price lowered). German window shuts 01.09 18:00Z; the Belgian window runs ~4 days longer, so an exit can complete after the German deadline - the risk does not end at 18:00Z. He is the worst scorer in the squad at ap 21, mv 9.096.588 with sdmvt -670.248 (~670k/day of decay), and he was always the designated sale. Sale allowance is ZERO until a buy lands (squad exactly 11) - see BUY B3z76og on Nguefack, which exists to unlock this. Dump to Kickbase at mv rather than list: a manager ask clears +3,06% to +4,35% (~280k-400k more) but takes days he does not have, and Keidel just proved the manager route works only when someone wants the player. Sell the moment the allowance exists.

standing.name: Bernardo
standing.why: Replaces Sydvapy (closed) and REVERSES its partial walk-back. Sydvapy said "the hooked-at-53 premise is NOT corroborated" and demoted this to a purely financial call. It IS corroborated, by Kickbase itself: get_player 1954 now returns st=2, stl=[2], stxt "Stricken - does not come through KOE (A) unscathed", status timestamp 2026-08-31T10:44:32Z. He picked up a knock in the MD1 game at Koeln - that is why he came off at 53 (Ligainsider confirms exactly 1 appearance / 53 minutes in 2026/27), and it was an injury hook, not a Hranac demotion. No club statement yet: Ligainsider's Bernardo profile still ends at 28.08.2026 "Bernardo meldet sich fuer Koeln zurueck" and he is NOT on the Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table, so treat this as doubtful, not ruled out. NOTE THE DATE TRAP that caught an earlier run: the "Bernardo faellt verletzungsbedingt aus" item (Ligainsider 408617 / the TSG tweet naming a Bayern away XI) is 08.02.2026, LAST SEASON - Hoffenheim's MD2 opponent is Dortmund on 2026-09-05T13:30Z, not Bayern. Effect on the plan: the case is no longer only financial. He is now a doubtful starter carrying ap 61 in a fielded XI that cannot be reshuffled at 11 players, and mv 6.547.852 with sdmvt -1.013.483 keeps bleeding ~1M/day. He OVERTAKES Sambi Lokonga (ap 44, fit, starter, mv falling only 190k/day) as the sale to make once Sylla and Suzuki are done: selling Bernardo and keeping Lokonga puts ap 44 into the XI in place of a flagged ap 61 and stops the faster bleed. Sell EARLY if sold at all.

buy.reason: ter Horst is the buy and the bid should not be raised. The recommended figure already sits above every mid-priced clearing ever measured in this league. The Vogt clearing on this same board today went far higher, but that was a cheap player where the absolute cost of overpaying was small; that premium does not transfer to a listing at this price level. This is a contested blind Kickbase listing, so the benchmark is the high cluster and never the median — bidding near the median is precisely how Campbell and Ebnoutalib were both lost. The Nguefack and Maluze bids stay exactly as placed. Maluze in particular has quietly improved since the last run and remains the best points-per-euro on the entire board. Eggestein stays an optional final leg only, taken at market value rather than at the manager's ask, and only if the earlier legs land. Everything else on the board is already logged as an avoid: the manager asks are running at three to four times the rate manager asks actually clear at here, and the cheap no-history bodies are all beaten on both price and points by Nguefack.

standing.name: ter Horst
standing.why: TOP MOVE. New Kickbase listing 31.08 16:44:32Z at EXACTLY mv 7.202.041, expires 2026-09-01T09:23Z. Paderborn DEF (tid 29 = Paderborn, NOT Stuttgart - correct an earlier ledger guess). ap 143, the best points-per-euro of any verified starter on this board: 19,9 ap per million of mv against Eggestein 7,3 and Vagnoman 10,5. VERIFIED 31.08: started MD1 in Paderborn's back three of a 3-4-3 at Mainz 29.08.2026 (fussballtransfers lineup: Noll - Hansen, Scheller, ter Horst - Obermair, Castaneda, Ulrich, Curda - Vidovic, Marino, Pieringer), 0:0 clean sheet, Kickbase sec=5731 = the full 95 min, smc=1 ismc=1, st=0 and empty stl, NOT on Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table. mv rising (mvt=1, +370.015 in the last hour). MD2 is Paderborn AT HOME to Freiburg. TWO JOBS AT ONCE: squad is 10 with ZERO legal formations and a live -100, so he is a body AND a points upgrade - he enters the XI ahead of Widmer ap 29 and the flagged Bernardo ap 61, worth roughly +126 ap on the fielded eleven. BID 8.800.000 = +22,19% over mv, deliberately above the +20,96% Campbell high-water mark: this is a contested blind KICKBASE listing, so the HIGH cluster is the benchmark and never the median - we lost Campbell bidding +4,09% into a +20,96% clearing and lost Ebnoutalib twice around +14-21%. Vogt cleared +72,17% on this same board today, so the high cluster is if anything widening. NOT a reversal of the Vagnoman AVOID: same slot, nearly double the points (143 v 73) for 6% more money. AFFORDABILITY: spending power 65.262.032, so the 33% floor is not binding. LEVERAGE: with Nguefack 900k + Maluze 1,2M + Eggestein 16,31M all live, this takes the balance to about -12,26M if everything lands. Unwind is comfortable and MUST be done before the lock - sell Sylla 9,10M + Bernardo 6,55M = +15,64M, leaving about +3,39M and a squad of 12 (1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT) that fields 5-3-2. Do NOT unwind with Sylla+Lokonga: that leaves 6DEF/2MID/2ATT, which fills no legal formation.

standing.name: Nguefack
standing.why: REVERSAL of the 12:48Z decision to close BUY Bkmihvw ("nothing needs doing tonight"). That was correct on the Suzuki MVP clock alone - it did not know about Sylla. NEW DATED FACT: fussballeuropa 31.08.2026 08:45Z - Club Brugge intends to bid for Moussa Sylla before the window shuts, Schalke has cut the asking price to a EUR 4M minimum and is only weighing whether it makes sporting sense; CEO Tillmann says a sale "is included in our budget figures". German window shuts 01.09 18:00Z, the Belgian window stays open ~4 more days, so an exit can complete AFTER the German deadline. Sylla is squad, ap 21, mv 9.096.588 falling 670k/day, and is funding leg 1. THE TRAP: squad is exactly 11, so sale allowance is ZERO until a buy lands. Georg physically cannot sell Sylla today. The earliest allowance is the Maluze auction at 2026-09-01T11:52Z - and only if it lands. Buying one cheap outfield body creates the allowance now instead of hoping. It was ALREADY the required fix in branches (b), (c) and (d) of the standing plan (3 of 4 branches); the Sylla story just removes the slack that justified deferring it. VERIFIED: Ligainsider 29.08.2026 18:57 - Gladbach Bundesliga debut v Leipzig, on at 64 for Stoeger, ~26 min, promoted to the senior squad in early August, fit, no status flag (st=0). ap 17 - he is a BODY for unwind capacity, not a points play, and must not be fielded over anyone. Kickbase blind auction at mv 714.900: bid the HIGH cluster, 900.000 = +25,9% over mv, absolute overpay risk ~185k. Sequence: bid now -> lands 02:11Z (balance -799k, briefly leveraged) -> SELL Sylla immediately -> +8,3M and squad back to 11 -> Maluze at 11:52Z restores allowance for the mandatory Suzuki sale. Every step stays positive from the Sylla sale onward and the leverage is unwound ~90h before the lock.

killed_this_run.name: Vagnoman
killed_this_run.why: REVERSAL of BUY Boleuh6 and RAISE Rf17mrr, both now closed unexecuted (no bid was ever placed - ofc=0 on the listing). Verified fit: full 90 at Bayern MD1, Hoeness backed him 29.08.2026 - but that same Ligainsider piece says he is NOT a guaranteed starter, only "needed urgently" with Assignon and Nartey injured. The reversal is not about him, it is about the unwind. Cash is 100.941 and live offers on Maluze (1,20M) + Eggestein (16,31M) already put the balance at -17.404.868 if both land. N buys permit exactly N sales, and with 2 buys the ONLY sale pair that clears zero is Lokonga+Sylla (19,73M -> +2,33M); every other pair leaves him negative at the lock = ZERO points for all of MD2. Adding Vagnoman at 8,30M (+19,88% over mv) forces a 3rd sale that must be Bernardo, whose mv is falling ~1M/day, on a margin of ~480k over four days. And the job Vagnoman was bought for is already done cheaper: Maluze ap 184 at 1,20M displaces Widmer ap 29. Vagnoman would only displace Bernardo ap 61 for +12 ap at 8,30M. Bad points-per-euro and it endangers the whole matchday.

movers.reason: No flip clears its cost this run. There are no manager asks below market value anywhere on the board, so the mechanism that would fund a flip is simply absent. What is visible instead is rivals flipping players back to Kickbase within minutes for fractions of a percent — three such pairs settled during this run alone, on Mohya, Urbig and Futkeu. That is motion, not points, and it is not worth copying, least of all while the squad cannot field a legal eleven.

fitness.sweep: Clean sweep, no new problems. Every squad player was checked against Ligainsider's injury and suspension table this run and none of them appear on it. Bernardo continues to carry a knock flag on Kickbase but is not listed as injured externally, which is consistent with the minor issue already on file and does not change his status as a funding sale. Two Sylla stories surfaced in search this run and both are date traps from the previous season's winter window — a collapsed move to New York City FC, reported in January, which is why he is still at Schalke and still in the squad. The live Sylla story remains the one already on file: a Champions League club circling before the deadline. The one genuinely dated item found this run is older than what the ledger already holds and adds nothing new.
